task.title: Apply a CIS layer
task.shortdesc: Add a supported CIS layer when the profile needs a hardened baseline from BPM’s mapped recommendations.

prereq.p: A profile draft and schema channel are selected.

context.p: The CIS layer is a BPM mapping aid; review every resulting setting for the deployment and do not treat it as certification.

info.p: Expected result: the Guided profile remains consistent.

step.cmd: Choose the supported CIS layer that matches the target channel and scenario.

info.p: Expected result: the Guided profile remains consistent.

step.cmd: Review the compliance-aware baseline changes in the summary.

info.p: Expected result: the Guided profile remains consistent.

step.cmd: Keep or adjust settings that conflict with the deployment goal.

info.note: Changing schema-dependent controls can make values invalid for the selected Firefox channel.

result.p: The profile includes the selected CIS layer as part of its baseline.

postreq.p: Recovery: if the layer is not suitable, remove it and revalidate before saving.
